artboards: 00-system-sheet (row anatomy inside the list-row example, timeline cell)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' #sys, the list-row example's timeline cell (5 dots: passed, passed, next, ahead, ahead); README.md §0.4 'Meters and timeline on every row' and 'Passed = filled green dot; next = larger dot in the item's band colour with a ring, ahead = hollow'
notes: The fixture (2 past, 1 current, 2 future entries) reproduces the artboard row example's own dot pattern (2 passed, 1 next, 2 ahead) so the artboard's own numbers are the comparison.

FIXED (fix58-lists, 2026-09-07, B-row 'the track green-to-next-dot finding'): dc.html #sys line 202 states the list-row track literally as `height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#16A34A 0,#16A34A 58%,rgba(0,0,0,.12) 58%)` — corrected from this spec's prior expect (height 1px, flat rgba(0,0,0,.12), no green) which had underscored a real, confirmed product gap instead of asserting the design's own stated value. MilestoneTimeline.tsx now renders the track as a single gradient with a hard colour stop at the 'next' dot's own position (green before it, rgba(0,0,0,.12) after), matching the artboard's technique exactly.

The artboard places dots at fixed pixel offsets (0, 24, 42, 58, 76px) within the 76px cell, so its gradient stop (58%) is measured against THOSE offsets; the built component uses `justify-content:space-between` across a `width:100%` row (an accepted, pre-existing layout-strategy difference — dot POSITION is not asserted below for the same reason). The gradient stop below is therefore this fixture's own space-between position for the 'next' dot (index 2 of 5, i.e. 50%), not the artboard's literal 58% — the CONVENTION (green-to-next, hard stop, rgba(0,0,0,.12) beyond) is what's asserted, computed consistently with the dots' own real positions rather than a borrowed fixed-px number.

Selectors reach dots by DOM order: MilestoneTimeline.tsx has no per-dot marker class, so nth-of-type addresses the classifier's output directly (dot 1/2 = passed, dot 3 = next, dot 4/5 = ahead, per milestone-timeline-classify.ts, proven independently by its own npmtest.mjs).

children.name: track line
children.note: dc.html #sys line 202: height 2px, linear-gradient green 0-58% (artboard's own fixed-px 'next' position) then rgba(0,0,0,.12) beyond. This fixture's 'next' dot sits at 50% under the built component's own space-between spacing (index 2 of 5) — see the spec's own notes above for why 50% and not 58%.

children.name: dot 3 — next (band colour, ring)
children.note: dc.html #sys: 8x8px, background is the band colour (#F97316 in the artboard's own example, matching this fixture's Action band), box-shadow ring (artboard: '0 0 0 2px #fff' — a white ring; the built component's ring is the band colour at 20% alpha, '0 0 0 2px <bandHex>33' — a real colour divergence, logged as the comparison). Built dot size is 9x9px, not 8x8px.
